mocks.search_book: [5.4 Carnot cycle] The efficiency of a Carnot engine is η = 1 − Tc/Th, where Tc is the absolute temperature of the cold reservoir and Th that of the hot reservoir, both in kelvin.

messages.content: What does my book say about the stages of wound healing? Draw them as a flowchart.

mocks.search_book: [8.2 Wound healing] Wound healing proceeds through four overlapping stages: haemostasis, in which a clot forms; inflammation, in which neutrophils and macrophages clear debris; proliferation, in which granulation tissue and new vessels form; and remodelling, in which collagen is reorganised over months.

messages.content: Find the kinetic energy formula in my notes and use it to work out the energy of a 1200 kg car moving at 25 m/s.

mocks.search_book: [2.1 Energy] Kinetic energy is KE = ½mv², with m in kilograms and v in metres per second; the result is in joules.

messages.content: Search my notes for the differences between the Doric, Ionic and Corinthian orders and make a comparison table.

mocks.search_book: [3.5 Classical orders] The Doric order has a plain cushion capital and no base; the Ionic order has a volute capital and a base; the Corinthian order has an ornate capital of acanthus leaves and a base. Doric columns are the stoutest and Corinthian the most slender.

messages.content: Read section 6.1 and make a glossary of the key terms in it.

mocks.read_section: [6.1 Pharmacokinetics] Absorption is the movement of a drug into the bloodstream. Distribution is its spread to tissues. Metabolism is its chemical conversion, mostly in the liver. Excretion is its removal, mostly by the kidneys. Half-life is the time for plasma concentration to fall by half.
